summary: Cross-system adjudication provenance/enforcement mechanism in src/adjudication.js and src/cli.js is implemented and its own 55 targeted tests pass, and independent reruns of two other e2e suites that also depend on adjudication.js still pass, so no regression was actually found. But the story's recorded verification evidence never exercised that broader surface, and the new warning states are invisible in the gate/report artifacts that a reviewer or gate consumer actually reads.

findings.detail: Recorded evidence covers only the story's own test files; other consumers of src/adjudication.js (judgment-dag-adjudication e2e, classifier-premise-recovery e2e) were verified only off-artifact by the reviewer.

buildJudgmentDagAdjudicationGate and summarizeJudgmentAdjudicationForPr do not surface warnings (provenance_missing / same_system) or provenance.same_system_override, so a passing gate silently hides that weight independence was never established or was overridden. Untested as well as unsurfaced.

judgment_delta: pass expectation -> needs_changes because recorded evidence is narrower than the shared module's consumer surface and warning states are silent in judgment-DAG gate/summary surfaces.
